baselinePublicSourceCheck: 9 of 9 canonical result URLs retrieved successfully from SEC or the corresponding issuer's public website; 5 pages explicitly printed the NCT and 4 require trial-name-to-official-registry crosswalk.
notes: All nine result URLs already existed on FOCUS canonical source records; this pass verifies and surfaces them, not new or independent publications.
Links to a sponsor result release must not be conflated with full clinical study report, published peer-reviewed study or signed pre-unblinding SAP.
SEC-hosted exhibits contain issuer statements; SEC hosting does not independently validate their clinical significance.

Direct exact NCT text appears on five of nine source-page mappings. Four map sponsor trial/program name to exact official ClinicalTrials.gov registry study NCT and must retain that weaker join provenance.
One Celldex release covers two EMBARQ trials; nine records map to eight unique original result pages.
FDA approvals, rejections, timing, statistical multiplicity, safety significance and certainty must remain unscored without independent scientific review.

records.title: Axsome Therapeutics Announces AXS-12 Achieves Primary Endpoint in the SYMPHONY Phase 3 Trial in Narcolepsy
records.note: SEC exhibit reports Axsome SYMPHONY results and narcolepsy cataplexy endpoints; NCT identity must be cross-reconciled with original registry study title (not printed in SEC release).

records.title: Axsome Therapeutics Announces AXS-12 Achieves Primary Endpoint in ENCORE Long-Term Phase 3 Trial in Narcolepsy
records.note: SEC exhibit reports Axsome ENCORE withdrawal-study findings; NCT identity is independently crosswalked by trial name in registry, not directly printed in SEC release.

records.title: Belite Bio Announces Positive Topline Results from Global Phase 3 DRAGON Trial of Tinlarebant in Stargardt Disease
records.note: Belite DRAGON study findings published as sponsor topline release; NCT05244304 identity is verified by the official DRAGON registry study title rather than the release printing an NCT identifier.

records.title: Celldex Phase 3 EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 Barzolvolimab Results
records.note: Original Celldex issuer release explicitly names exact NCT06445023 and NCT06455202; sponsor-reported results are not an independent trial-level signed SAP/statistical adjudication.

records.title: Celldex Phase 3 EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 Barzolvolimab Results
records.note: Same original issuer release explicitly identifies NCT06455202 as EMBARQ-CSU2 and NCT06445023 as EMBARQ-CSU1. One page does not imply independent review for two trials.

records.title: Cogent Biosciences Reports Results from Bezuclastinib PEAK Phase 3 Trial in GIST
records.note: Sponsor release reports PEAK bezuclastinib GIST results. The PEAK sponsor trial name matches NCT05208047 official registry; this original release does not print the exact NCT string.

records.title: Immunome Reports Detailed Phase 3 RINGSIDE Data for Varegacestat at 2026 ASCO
records.note: Original May 30, 2026 ASCO result disclosure explicitly identifies NCT04871282; reported ovarian toxicity and treatment discontinuation figures still require independent denominator and exposure reconciliation.

records.title: Pharvaris Announces CHAPTER-3 Pivotal Phase 3 Results of Deucrictibant XR
records.note: SEC exhibit explicitly identifies CHAPTER-3 as NCT06669754 and reports treatment arm denominators 55 versus 30. Source claims await independent efficacy, multiplicity, and safety review.

records.title: Praxis Announces Topline Results from Two Pivotal Essential3 Phase 3 Studies of Ulixacaltamide
records.note: Original issuer release directly links NCT06087276 and reports two simultaneous designs (parallel-group and randomized-withdrawal), requiring distinct analysis-population and multiplicity review.
